guidance.home: Help find the right agency service, outline a brief or request a consultant slot. Do not repeat the welcome.
guidance.catalog: Recommend service packages using search_catalog for the stated business goal and budget. Prices are estimates.
guidance.service_package: Use get_service_package for the selected package. Explain scope and requirements. Offer a consultation; final proposal requires human confirmation.
guidance.team: Compare consultants and specialties. Use search_team for real slots, with companies=1.
guidance.consultant: Discuss the selected consultant. Use check_consultation_availability for an actual 60-minute slot.
guidance.facilities: Explain stored collaboration process steps using search_knowledge.
guidance.facility_detail: Explain the selected process step using search_knowledge. Do not invent contract terms.
guidance.consultation: Help complete the 60-minute consultation request, one company per consultant slot. Confirm the full summary before submission. No automatic payment.
guidance.handover: Offer request_human_handover or available contact buttons for the agency team.
